request: We need a message broker that sustains 300,000 durable (persisted, replicated) messages per second of 1 KB each, on at most 6 nodes. The vendor of 'StreamCore' says it does 1 million messages per second. Compare StreamCore with 'QueueForge' using the attached documents and recommend one.

fixtures.name: streamcore-blog.md
fixtures.content:
# StreamCore 4.0: one million messages per second
Vendor blog, 2026-04-02

In our lab, StreamCore 4.0 sustained 1,000,000 msg/s on a 3-node cluster with 100-byte messages, in-memory mode (persistence disabled), replication factor 1.

fixtures.name: independent-benchmark.md
fixtures.content:
# Independent broker benchmark (TechBench Labs, 2026-08)
Setup: 1 KB messages, fsync per batch, replication factor 3, 6 nodes, p99 latency target < 50 ms.

| broker | sustained msg/s | p99 latency |
|---|---|---|
| StreamCore 4.0 | 220,000 | 38 ms |
| QueueForge 2.3 | 410,000 | 61 ms |

Note: QueueForge achieved 340,000 msg/s with p99 < 50 ms. StreamCore was CPU bound on replication.

fixtures.name: queueforge-docs.md
fixtures.content:
# QueueForge 2.3 operations guide (excerpt)
- Recommended max partitions per node: 4,000
- Rebalancing after node loss can take 10-20 minutes at high partition counts, during which throughput may drop up to 40%.
- Licence: open source (Apache 2.0); commercial support optional.

expected.summary: The vendor's 1M msg/s figure is not comparable (100-byte, in-memory, RF1). Under the user's durable 1 KB RF3 conditions the independent benchmark shows StreamCore at 220k (below 300k) and QueueForge at 410k (340k at p99<50ms), so QueueForge meets the requirement with limited headroom; but its rebalancing can cut throughput up to 40% (to ~204k-246k), below 300k during recovery. Recommend QueueForge conditionally with a proof-of-concept under the exact workload and capacity planning for failure scenarios.

mustFlag.description: QueueForge rebalancing degradation could drop below requirement

mustNotClaim.description: Recommends StreamCore as meeting the requirement

criticalFailures: Accepts the vendor's 1M msg/s claim as applicable to the requirement
Recommends StreamCore as meeting 300k durable msg/s
